verdict.rationale: Docs show the API exposes a broad set of search capabilities that mirror the consumer Brave Search UI — web, image, video, news, local/POI, rich verticals (sports/stocks/weather), Goggles re-ranking, safesearch, summarizer/AI answers, and an LLM-optimized context endpoint (brave-search-api-docs-2,6,9,11,16,17,24,27,28,29,36). However, there is no explicit documentation stating full feature parity with the UI, no OpenAPI spec surfaced (brave-search-api-probe-3), and community evidence flags a ToS restriction that could limit certain AI-use cases without upgrading plans (brave-search-api-comm-1,2). Missing for 10: explicit UI-vs-API parity statement, confirmation no UI-only features (e.g. account personalization) are absent from API, and independent verification of full functional equivalence.
